name: @isabella/canon
description: Formally verified lattice cryptography from Isabelle/HOL

scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:ts && npm run build:esm && npm run copy:runtime
scripts.build:runtime: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/isabella.js dist/isabella.cjs && cd ../isabella.ml && eval $(opam env) && dune build src/js/isabella_js.bc.js && cp _build/default/src/js/isabella_js.bc.js ../isabella.ts/dist/isabella.js && cp _build/default/src/js/isabella_js.bc.js ../isabella.ts/dist/isabella.cjs
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist/*.js dist/*.mjs dist/*.d.ts dist/*.map dist/*.cjs

author: Isabella Project
